guard_1/greet_1.mp3.text: Keep your blade sheathed inside the fence.

guard_1/greet_3.mp3.text: Wolves on the east road again. Stay on the paths.

guard_1/greet_5.mp3.text: If you see goblins, you come and tell the Watch. Don't play the hero.

guard_1/startled_1.mp3.text: Hey! Put that away before someone gets hurt.

guard_1/startled_3.mp3.text: Try that again and you'll spend the night in the stocks.
